description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment class 'SynchronizedNotificationsFragment' that manages notifications and interaction with wearable devices via GoogleApiClient. It includes methods for building local notifications, wearable-only notifications, and mirrored notifications that synchronize notification dismissal between a phone and a wearable device.

classes.name: SynchronizedNotificationsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI for triggering various notification patterns on a phone and across connected wearables, including local, wearable-only, and mirrored notifications with synchronization capabilities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and prepares the fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to trigger different notification behaviors.

methods.name: buildLocalOnlyNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a local notification, optionally with a dismissal intent.

methods.name: buildWearableOnlyNotification
methods.description: Creates a data item that causes a notification to appear solely on the wearable.

methods.name: buildMirroredNotifications
methods.description: Creates a pair of notifications that are synchronized across device and wearable, with dismissal linkage.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is suspended.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the current time.
